description: Reusable parchment, semantic ink controls and native provider adapters.

parameters.label: Enabled
parameters.description: When true, install the DesignSystem presentation hooks and expose CoretoDesignSystem at boot. False returns before either is created; provider-owned preset callbacks already written to Options/Save are independent and remain configured.

parameters.label: Windows
parameters.description: When true, theme eligible MZ windows, choice rows, dialogue spacing and option rectangles. False skips these window hooks and corner-cursor placement; exported drawing helpers and configured picture-role decoration remain available. ScrollText, MapName, picture-text windows and non-menu ButtonAssist are excluded from the ordinary window-surface replacement.

parameters.label: Surfaces
parameters.description: Palette used by drawing helpers and window/picture feedback. Every value is a #RRGGBB string. The panel color is overridden at runtime by active Core Engine itemBackColor1; text, heading and muted colors come from Core Engine rather than this object.

fields.label: canvas
fields.description: Exported canvas palette color for game-owned drawing. Current built-in window and picture renderers do not paint a canvas from this value. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

fields.label: panel
fields.description: Fallback light panel fill. With the required active Coreto Core Engine, CoretoDesignSystem.colors.panel instead reads ColorManager.itemBackColor1(); change that provider setting to change live panel fill. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

fields.label: disabled
fields.description: Fill for disabled buttons/fields and the unfilled volume-track recipe. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

fields.label: onAccent
fields.description: Text/icon ink on selected, pressed or primary surfaces; also dialogue ink on dark message backgrounds. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

fields.label: border
fields.description: Ordinary control and window border color. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

fields.label: subtle
fields.description: Card stripe, inner message border and picture-panel outline color. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

fields.label: primary
fields.description: Fill for selected or primary controls and the captured volume-control recipe. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

fields.label: pressed
fields.description: Fill while a control is pressed; also used by the captured selected volume track. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

fields.label: purple
fields.description: Exported palette color for game-owned drawing. Current built-in renderers use primary/focus/accentHover instead. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

fields.label: menuSelectedHoverBorder
fields.description: Border color when a selected menu-kind button is hovered. Other selected controls keep the gold border. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

fields.label: focus
fields.description: Hovered-control border and focused-field border color. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

fields.label: gold
fields.description: Selected-control border and explicit focused-button outer ring; also captured volume feedback. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

fields.label: error
fields.description: Error-state border in drawField. The error icon retains its source artwork colors. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

fields.label: hover
fields.description: Fill for an unselected light control under the pointer. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

fields.label: accentHover
fields.description: Hover fill for selected or primary controls. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

fields.label: card
fields.description: Static card fill for paper/default contexts, including Window_Help and configured card pictures. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

fields.label: cardScene
fields.description: Static card fill when drawCard receives context scene. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

fields.label: cardMemorial
fields.description: Static card fill when drawCard receives context memorial. Supply a JSON string in #RRGGBB format, for example "#704737".

parameters.label: Shapes
parameters.description: Pixel dimensions for rounded surfaces, borders and focus rings. Used by window/picture rendering and the public drawing helpers; a corner radius is capped at half the drawn width/height.

fields.label: ControlRadius
fields.description: Rounded-control corner radius in pixels, capped by half the rendered dimensions.

fields.label: PanelRadius
fields.description: Window and picture-panel corner radius in pixels, capped by half the rendered dimensions.

fields.label: MenuSelectedWidth
fields.description: Border width in pixels for a resting selected menu-kind button. Hover uses FocusWidth; pressed/disabled uses BorderWidth.

fields.label: BorderWidth
fields.description: Ordinary control/field border width in pixels. Zero is accepted as a drawing value, not an off switch for the surface or its border.

fields.label: FocusWidth
fields.description: Hovered/selected control and focused-field border width in pixels; also width of the explicit outer focus ring.

fields.label: FocusGap
fields.description: Gap in pixels outside a drawButton rectangle before its explicit focused ring; the ring bounds expand by FocusGap + FocusWidth on every side.

fields.label: Inset
fields.description: Inset in pixels from each edge of the message window for its inner decorative outline.

parameters.label: Card
parameters.description: Pixel spacing for static card surfaces and drawCard text. Window_Help uses the surface stripe, while its native text inset is separately fixed at 16 pixels.

fields.label: StripeX
fields.description: Horizontal stripe offset in pixels from the card rectangle left edge; positive moves right.

fields.label: StripeWidth
fields.description: Width in pixels of the vertical card stripe.

fields.label: PaddingY
fields.description: Top/bottom stripe inset and drawCard text top/bottom padding in pixels.

fields.label: TextInset
fields.description: drawCard text offset in pixels from the rectangle left edge; reduces available wrapping width.

fields.label: PaddingRight
fields.description: Right-side space in pixels excluded from drawCard wrapping width.

parameters.label: Button
parameters.description: Pixel spacing for menu-button markers and drawButton text. MinHeight also sets a floor for choice rows; it does not resize every native button.

fields.label: PaddingX
fields.description: Horizontal padding in pixels inside drawButton. Menu/choice text additionally reserves marker size and gap.

fields.label: MinHeight
fields.description: Minimum choice-row height in pixels. The native row height and tallest wrapped label can raise the final height.

fields.label: MarkerSize
fields.description: Diamond marker side length in pixels for menu-kind buttons and title choices.

fields.label: MarkerGap
fields.description: Horizontal gap in pixels reserved after the menu/title-choice diamond.

parameters.label: Choice
parameters.description: Pixel spacing and maximum width of choice entries when Windows is true; drawButton with kind choice also uses its marker settings.

fields.label: MarkerSize
fields.description: Diamond marker side length in pixels for ordinary choices.

fields.label: MarkerGap
fields.description: Horizontal gap in pixels reserved after an ordinary choice diamond.

fields.label: PaddingY
fields.description: Space in pixels added above and below the tallest measured choice label when computing row height.

fields.label: MaxWidth
fields.description: Maximum choice-content width in pixels, further limited by screen width, columns and spacing. CLI minimum is 80. Wrapping preserves whole words, so a single oversized word is not split.

parameters.label: Dialogue
parameters.description: Dialogue composition when Windows is true. MessageCore retains text parsing and ExtMessageFunc retains cursor artwork, animation and offsets.

fields.label: ContinuePlacement
fields.description: corner places an enabled ExtMessageFunc custom continue cursor near the message bottom-right, retaining provider offsets. provider leaves its placement to ExtMessageFunc. Requires Windows=true and an active custom cursor; it does not enable the cursor.

fields.label: SpeakerInside
fields.description: True reserves speaker space at the start of message text and places the NameBox inside the message panel; false retains provider placement. Only messages with a speaker name reserve space. Forced-position/auto-sized messages skip the added window-height calculation.

fields.label: SpeakerGap
fields.description: Extra vertical pixels between an embedded speaker line and message text; added to Speaker.Line.

fields.label: TextInset
fields.description: Horizontal pixels added to the provider message line start. Also offsets embedded NameBox placement from the left and the corner cursor from the right, with provider offsets added.

fields.label: ContrastOutline
fields.description: Text-outline width in pixels on dim/transparent message backgrounds and unadapted scrolling text. Paper backgrounds use MessageCore DefaultOutlineWidth instead; outline color remains Core Engine/native.

parameters.label: Field
parameters.description: Pixel dimensions for drawField; Height also controls the background drawn behind native actor-name input when Windows is true.

fields.label: Height
fields.description: Field background height in pixels; drawField uses it for value text and native actor-name input uses it for its backdrop.

fields.label: PaddingX
fields.description: Horizontal pixels inset on both sides of drawField value text.

fields.label: Gap
fields.description: Vertical pixel gap between drawField label and value surface, and between that surface and helper text.

parameters.label: Controls
parameters.description: Visual dimensions captured into the delivered Options/Save drawing recipes. Editing these DesignSystem parameters alone does not rewrite provider callbacks. See package docs/integration.md for preset ownership and reapplication.

fields.label: OptionHeight
fields.description: Exposed configuration value for custom recipes. The current runtime and shipped drawing recipes do not read OptionHeight; changing it alone does not resize Options rows.

fields.label: ValueRatio
fields.description: Captured option-recipe value-column start as a percentage of row width: x = row.x + row.width * ValueRatio / 100. CLI accepts values strictly between 0 and 100. Current provider callbacks retain the values captured when their recipe was authored.

fields.label: TrackHeight
fields.description: Volume-track height in pixels captured into the Options drawing recipe; no direct live runtime consumer.

fields.label: ThumbWidth
fields.description: Volume-thumb width in pixels captured into the Options drawing recipe; no direct live runtime consumer.

fields.label: ThumbHeight
fields.description: Volume-thumb height in pixels captured into the Options drawing recipe; no direct live runtime consumer.

fields.label: SaveHeader
fields.description: Top space in pixels reserved above save preview art/description by the captured Save contents recipe.

fields.label: SaveFooter
fields.description: Bottom space in pixels reserved below save preview art/description by the captured Save contents recipe. Preview height is max(0, row.height - SaveHeader - SaveFooter).

parameters.label: OptionsLayout
parameters.description: Pixel geometry for OptionsCore category/list rectangles when Windows is true and those provider methods exist. Offsets add to the provider rectangle; margins replace its horizontal bounds.

fields.label: Margin
fields.description: Left/right margin in pixels for both Options rectangles: x = Margin; width = Graphics.boxWidth - 2 * Margin.

fields.label: CategoryHeight
fields.description: Replacement category-window height in pixels.

fields.label: CategoryOffsetY
fields.description: Nonnegative vertical pixels added to the provider category-window y position; positive moves down.

parameters.label: PictureRoles
parameters.description: Complete JSON array of {Image,Role} mappings for existing img/pictures/<Image>.png assets, without extension. Images must be unique nonempty ASCII letter/digit/underscore/space/hyphen basenames. [] removes all configured mappings on restart. secondary draws a light button, primary a filled action button, card a static striped surface, panel a rounded panel. The surface replaces the displayed bitmap at the original image dimensions; it does not create pictures, clicks or choices. PictureChoices or an adapter owns interaction. A registered pictures adapter can replace this lookup.

items.label: PictureRole
items.description: One complete picture-role object. Author the entire array through /PictureRoles; item paths are not separate CLI selectors. The editor item default has an empty Image, which must be replaced by an existing valid basename before CLI insertion.

fields.label: Image
fields.description: Existing img/pictures image basename without extension; ASCII letters, digits, underscores, spaces and hyphens only. Must be nonempty and unique in /PictureRoles.

fields.label: Role
fields.description: secondary = light button; primary = filled action button; card = static striped surface; panel = rounded panel. These replace visual surfaces only; interaction is owned by PictureChoices or a registered adapter.

parameters.label: Parchment atlas
parameters.description: 192px MZ atlas with transparent irregular edges in img/system.

methods.label: style
methods.description: Return typography for a named role. Dialogue uses the current game font; unknown roles throw.
methods.context: MZ runtime after enabled DesignSystem loads; see design-system api describe /Enabled for activation. The CLI only describes this API and never invokes it. Call style(role) with Dialogue, ChoiceText, Title, Section, Speaker, Menu, Action, Input, Label, Helper or Body. It returns a new object with the configured Face/Size and, where defined, Line. Dialogue requires initialized $gameSystem and derives Line = mainFontSize() + 6. ChoiceText derives Line from active MessageCore (fallback 24). Body has no Line; use a role with Line for measure. No special this binding or mutation is required.
methods.returns: Typography object; unknown configuration names throw.

methods.label: measure
methods.description: Measure wrapped text on an MZ Bitmap; restores its prior font and text properties.
methods.context: MZ runtime after enabled DesignSystem loads; see design-system api describe /Enabled for activation. The CLI only describes this API and never invokes it. Call measure(bitmap, text, width, role = "Helper") with an MZ Bitmap, string-convertible text and available pixel width. Use a role with Face/Size/Line. It wraps at whitespace and explicit newlines, preserves empty lines, and does not split oversized words or interpret escape codes. It measures only: no pixels are drawn. Font/outline/text-color properties are restored after measurement. No special this binding.
methods.returns: {lines: string[], width: max(0, supplied width), height: lines.length * Line, lineHeight: Line}. Width is the supplied layout width, not the widest glyph extent.

methods.label: drawButton
methods.description: Draw a themed button from its rectangle, label and interaction state.
methods.context: Existing (bitmap,rect,label,state,kind,focused) signature. Semantic text feedback: menu/choice/primary receive feather, other actions underline only. No background or glow.
methods.returns: undefined; bitmap pixels and text properties are modified.
methods.example:
const bitmap = new Bitmap(320, 80);
CoretoDesignSystem.drawButton(bitmap, {x:8,y:8,width:280,height:56}, "Continue", "selected", "menu", true);

methods.label: drawField
methods.description: Draw a labeled field with helper or error feedback.
methods.context: MZ runtime after enabled DesignSystem loads; see design-system api describe /Enabled for activation. The CLI only describes this API and never invokes it. Call drawField(bitmap, options) with an MZ Bitmap and object {x,y,width,label,value,helper,state}. Defaults are x=0, y=0, width=480, empty strings and state="default". Coordinates and width are pixels. default draws ordinary border, focused draws focus border, error adds error border/icon when helper is nonempty, disabled changes the fill. Labels/value are plain text; helper wraps on whitespace. It draws a representation, not an editable input, and leaves bitmap font/color properties modified. No special this binding. The caller owns the destination bitmap and must destroy it when no longer needed.
methods.returns: Number: total drawn field/helper height in pixels; helper text can exceed one line.
methods.example:
const bitmap = new Bitmap(480, 200);
const height = CoretoDesignSystem.drawField(bitmap, {x:8,y:8,width:440,label:"Name",value:"Reid",helper:"Shown in dialogue",state:"focused"});

methods.label: drawCard
methods.description: Draw a card and wrapped text; return the content height.
methods.context: Existing signature retained. Draws shared parchment and informative text; no dark alternate surface.
methods.returns: Number: wrapped text height + 2 * Card.PaddingY in pixels; this does not resize the rectangle or bitmap.
methods.example:
const bitmap = new Bitmap(400, 180);
const height = CoretoDesignSystem.drawCard(bitmap, {x:0,y:0,width:400,height:180}, "A memory of the journey", "memorial");

methods.label: drawIcon
methods.description: Draw a loaded themed icon; pending images are not drawn.
methods.context: MZ runtime after enabled DesignSystem loads; see design-system api describe /Enabled for activation. The CLI only describes this API and never invokes it. Call drawIcon(bitmap, name, x, y, size = 32, color = CoretoDesignSystem.colors.text). name is a key from /Icons, not a filename or IconSet index. x/y are top-left destination pixels; size is height and width preserves source aspect ratio. Unknown or not-yet-ready images draw nothing; call again after loading, no redraw is queued. error, Conversation and diamond retain source colors; others are tinted with the CSS color. Tinted bitmaps are cached (up to 64) until eviction or dispose. No special this binding. The caller owns the destination bitmap and must destroy it when no longer needed.
methods.returns: undefined; draws into the destination bitmap when the named image is ready.

methods.label: drawItemBackground
methods.description: Draw the native selectable row background; call with the window as receiver.
methods.context: Call with a selectable window and index. Clears the item background for ink controls; returns false when Windows=false. No colored rectangle or selection diamond.
methods.returns: Boolean: true when this window was themed, false when excluded.
methods.example:
const window = SceneManager._scene._commandWindow;
if (window && window.index() >= 0) CoretoDesignSystem.drawItemBackground.call(window, window.index());

methods.label: registerAdapter
methods.description: Replace named presentation callbacks: scrollOnPaper, choiceBadgeWidth, pictures, pictureState. Gameplay and persistence remain owned by the caller. In 1.6.0: pictureText(picture,zone,rawText) returns display-only text; picturePresentation.slot accepts footer-start, footer-center, footer-end or panel-heading; pictureState.checked adds a selection seal. Native text and campaign state are not modified.
methods.context: Register observational callbacks. Existing hooks remain accepted. New: choiceFeedback, choiceBadge, interfaceHidden, consumeInput, picturePresentation, pictureContext, pictureIndicator, pictureAction and pictureState. See docs/integration.md for contracts. No serialization.
methods.returns: undefined; replaces only the recognized callbacks supplied as functions.

methods.label: dispose
methods.description: Destroy cached tinted icon bitmaps and clear the cache.
methods.context: MZ runtime after enabled DesignSystem loads; see design-system api describe /Enabled for activation. The CLI only describes this API and never invokes it. Call dispose() to destroy and clear cached tinted icon bitmaps. Original loaded images, picture-owned surfaces, window hooks, configuration and registered adapters remain. Later drawIcon calls can recreate tint entries. Repeated calls on an empty cache do nothing. No arguments or special this binding.
methods.returns: undefined; clears only the tint cache, not the entire theme.

methods.label: drawParchment
methods.description: (bitmap,x,y,width,height,frame=true): tiled transparent-edge parchment atlas.
methods.context: MZ runtime after enabled DesignSystem loads. Presentation only; no game or save mutation.

methods.label: drawBrush
methods.description: (bitmap,left,top,right,bottom): opaque ivory support behind text and selection seal.
methods.context: MZ runtime after enabled DesignSystem loads. Presentation only; no game or save mutation.

methods.label: drawQuill
methods.description: (bitmap,x,y,color?,size?): code-native feather, default 24px.
methods.context: MZ runtime after enabled DesignSystem loads. Presentation only; no game or save mutation.

methods.label: drawSeal
methods.description: (bitmap,x,y,color?): broken purple wax disk with asymmetric drips in a 24px reservation.
methods.context: MZ runtime after enabled DesignSystem loads. Presentation only; no game or save mutation.

methods.label: drawControl
methods.description: (window,rect,state,draw): semantic feedback choice/secondary/icon/none, enabled/focused/checked/support.
methods.context: MZ runtime after enabled DesignSystem loads. Presentation only; no game or save mutation.

methods.label: drawLabel
methods.description: (window,text,rect,state,role,align): localized wrapped label with reserved indicator space.
methods.context: MZ runtime after enabled DesignSystem loads. Presentation only; no game or save mutation.

methods.label: drawIconControl

limits: The independent package CLI installs fonts, theme images and optional consumer profiles. The complete preset also requires OptionsCore and SaveCore. Parameters are read at boot; restart after authoring. No gameplay or persistence ownership.

apis.label: version
apis.context: Read CoretoDesignSystem.version in the game after Enabled=true initializes the plugin; see design-system api describe /Enabled. CLI discovery does not read a running game. Persisted changes use parameters and restart. Scene changes/save loading do not reload this boot configuration.

apis.label: config
apis.description: Boot-time configuration merged from catalog defaults and the plugin registry. Missing fields use defaults; arrays replace their defaults. The exported outer API is frozen, but this object is not a persistence or live-update API: use CLI parameter authoring and restart.
apis.context: Read CoretoDesignSystem.config in the game after Enabled=true initializes the plugin; see design-system api describe /Enabled. CLI discovery does not read a running game. Persisted changes use parameters and restart. Scene changes/save loading do not reload this boot configuration.

apis.label: colors
apis.description: Surface palette with live getters: panel reads active CoreEngine itemBackColor1, text reads normalColor, heading reads systemColor, and muted follows text. Other surface values come from boot configuration; reading the object does not draw or persist anything.
apis.context: Read CoretoDesignSystem.colors in the game after Enabled=true initializes the plugin; see design-system api describe /Enabled. CLI discovery does not read a running game. Persisted changes use parameters and restart. Scene changes/save loading do not reload this boot configuration.

apis.label: fonts
apis.description: Exposed family names: body=CoretoOutfit and medium=CoretoOutfitMedium are fixed, speaker reads Speaker.Face and title reads Title.Face at boot. This does not register/load fonts or mirror a later Body.Face edit.
